```         
{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}

metrics1 <- read.csv("neuralbandit3_original_metrics_plain.csv")

metrics2 <- read.csv("neuralbandit3_original_metrics_conceptdrift.csv")

metrics3 <- read_csv("neuralbandit3_original_metrics.csv")

ggplot(metrics1, aes(x = step, y = rolling_reward)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "NeuralBandit3: Rolling Reward Normal",
    x = "Training Steps",
    y = "Rolling Reward"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

metrics2$drift_event <- as.logical(metrics2$drift_event)

drift_points <- metrics2 %>%
  filter(drift_event == TRUE) %>%
  pull(step)

ggplot(metrics2, aes(x = step, y = rolling_reward)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = drift_points,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "NeuralBandit3: Rolling Reward w/ Concept Drift",
    x = "Training Steps",
    y = "Rolling Reward"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

metrics3$drift_event <- as.logical(metrics3$drift_event)

drift_points <- metrics3 %>%
  filter(drift_event == TRUE) %>%
  pull(step)

ggplot(metrics3, aes(x = step, y = rolling_reward)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = drift_points,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "red"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "NeuralBandit3: Rolling Reward w/ Concept Drift",
    x = "Training Steps",
    y = "Rolling Reward"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Check the column names
names(metrics2)

# Check the values stored in drift_event
table(metrics2$drift_event, useNA = "ifany")

# Check how many drift points were found
length(drift_points)

# Display the actual drift points
drift_points
```
